text: steenbarger: "may add to an existing exposure rather than a new idea." On C23 it does: same sector as held V. My answer is concentrate, not widen. MA is the one at a new high on above-bar volume; V is a hold, not a breakout. If MA is taken, the PM's question is whether V is the weaker holding to force out, not whether to carry both. SUPPORT stays at 2: late past 5% of the pivot (C17), no add-ons. A new high on fading volume ends it.
